title: US officials tell CNN: Iran weighing options for a dirty-bomb or chemical attack on DC officials; White House says no credible threat
summary: CNN reports, citing 7 US officials, that US intelligence indicates Iran has been weighing plans or options for a possible dirty-bomb or chemical attack on senior US officials in Washington, DC. The officials describe this as a contingency, not an imminent attack. The White House says there are no credible threats. Iran's UN mission calls the report fabricated. Other outlets carry the story and cite CNN. The desk has not confirmed it.

title: CNN and CBS report NSA's classified internal network is down; officials see no evidence of a cyberattack so far; NSA has not commented
summary: CNN first reported, citing six people familiar, that the NSA's classified internal network, known as NSA Net, is down. CBS News, citing US officials it spoke to, reports the network went offline Tuesday and that the agency staggered arrival times at Fort Meade. Two officials told CBS there is no evidence so far of a cyberattack, and two sources said routine system patching was the cause. How long the network has been down is not clear. The NSA has not commented in the reports. The desk has not confirmed it.

sources.scope: US officials who spoke to CBS News
